            const uint64_t delta = coordinate(key) - coordinate(lo_key);

            int32_t mid;
            if (normalized_range < static_cast<uint64_t>(hi - lo))
                mid = lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1);

                const uint64_t reciprocal = (static_cast<uint64_t>(hi - lo) << 32) / normalized_range + 1;

                mid = offset > static_cast<uint64_t>(hi - lo) ? hi : lo + static_cast<int32_t>(offset);
